article.title: Natural rubber and synthetic rubber prices jump on supply disruption; tyre counters gain in trade
article.text: Spot natural rubber prices jumped after unseasonal rain disrupted tapping across the main producing belts, while crude-linked synthetic rubber and carbon black also quoted higher. Tyre makers buy both. Apollo Tyres, whose replacement-market pricing typically follows an input move by a quarter, faces the full basket. Traders noted that tyre counters nevertheless gained in trade, with the Ceat scrip rallying hardest on the day as the market read the disruption as short-lived.
article.note: Blueprint §32 scenario 20 -- MARKET/FUNDAMENTAL DIVERGENCE (the Apollo shape, spec §62). The fundamental thesis is NEGATIVE (a raw-material basket that reprices ahead of the replacement-market price increase) while the observed reaction on the day is POSITIVE. Two separate truths, and the engine must publish the first WITHOUT letting the second edit it: APOLLOTYRE publishes as a negative primary, and CEAT -- named in the very same sentence, and reachable as a subject exactly like Apollo -- is rejected outright because the only thing said about it is that its scrip rallied. INV-003: a price move is a market fact, never fundamental evidence, and it can neither create a row nor flip one. The MEASURED half of the divergence (excess move -> reaction_direction -> the divergence sentence on the card) is a separate truth this offline corpus deliberately carries no price bars for (INV-002); it is pinned by tests/test_feed_primary_only.py::test_new_fields_present_including_divergence_for_apollo_case.

ground_truth.rationale: The divergence fixture pins the half the analysis engine owns: the FUNDAMENTAL claim must be published on its own evidence and must be unmoved by the day's price action. APOLLOTYRE is the article's subject at distance 1 with a real input-cost mechanism, so it publishes as a NEGATIVE primary even though the article's own text reports the tyre counters gaining -- that contradiction is the product's signal (§62's divergence line), not a defect to be smoothed away by softening the thesis. CEAT is the control on the other side: it is named in the same sentence and is equally reachable as an article subject, but the only thing the candidate says about it is that its scrip rallied, so classify_evidence taints it ARTICLE_MARKET_OBSERVATION before any tier logic runs and EVIDENCE_VALID rejects it (INV-003). A stock that went up is not thereby a beneficiary, and a stock that went up cannot flip the sign of a company whose costs just rose.
